name: build-goals
description: A focused toolkit for clarifying goals and building verifiable Agent Skills, plugins, and complete product PRDs.

interface.shortDescription: Clarify goals and build Skills, plugins, and PRDs
interface.longDescription: A focused toolkit that turns clarified goals into designed, implemented, validated, and deliverable Agent Skills, Claude Code or Codex plugins, and research-backed product requirements documents.
defaultPrompt: Use clarify-goal to resolve a goal, its scope, and its key decisions.
Use build-skill or build-plugin to create a verifiable Agent capability.
Use build-prd to turn an existing product or early idea into a research-backed, fully decided PRD, or handoff to prepare the next session.
